comparison.objective: Seat an add-on board on two header-pin rows without bending pins; candidate installs a rack rail.
comparison.physical_skill: Fine parallel multi-pin alignment and low-tilt insertion versus long-rail support, tab depression, paired spring-prong insertion at separated posts, telescoping, and fastening.
comparison.success_condition: Board seated to 0.3 mm without exceeding tilt-based bend gates versus four prongs latched at one rack unit, springs extended, correct screws, and self-support.
comparison.reason: Both test multi-point insertion, but the candidate adds staged latch actuation, retained front engagement, large-span leveling, articulation, and load-bearing fastening—meaningfully different abilities.
